paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range $74\mbox{--}110\,μ\mathrm{eV}/c^2$ with a Cryogenic Millimeter-Wave Receiver
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (plotted as chi x10^-10)
notes: Cryogenic millimeter-wave receiver DPDM search, 18-26.5 GHz (74-110 ueV). Paper reports chi < (0.3-2.0)e-10 across the mass range but does not provide per-frequency tabulated values; the two endpoint values are approximate representations of the stated bound range. Mass values from hν0=mDPc2 (74 ueV = 7.4e-5 eV, 110 ueV = 1.1e-4 eV).
